title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Thunder Valley Casino Resort, Lincoln | 2026
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Thunder Valley Casino Resort in Lincoln, California, USA, on 5 June 2026.

It was the sixth show of the 16th All-Starr Band’s tour of the USA, which lasted for 12 dates in May and June 2026.

Starr had previously performed at the Thunder Valley Casino Resort on 30 August 2019 and 9 June 2023.

The 16th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Buck Johnson: vocals, keyboards
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet

  • ‘Matchbox’
  • It Don’t Come Easy
  • ‘Rosanna’ (Steve Lukather)
  • ‘Pick Up The Pieces’ (Hamish Stuart)
  • ‘Down Under’ (Colin Hay)
  • ‘Boys’
  • ‘I’m The Greatest’
  • ‘Yellow Submarine’
  • ‘Cut The Cake’ (Hamish Stuart)
  • ‘Octopus’s Garden’
  • ‘No No Song’
  • ‘Choose Love’
  • ‘Overkill’ (Colin Hay)
  • ‘Africa’ (Steve Lukather)
  • ‘Work To Do’ (Hamish Stuart)
  • ‘I Wanna Be Your Man’
  • ‘Who Can It Be Now?’ (Colin Hay)
  • ‘Hold The Line’ (Steve Lukather)
  • ‘Photograph’
  • ‘Act Naturally’
  • ‘With A Little Help From My Friends’
  • ‘Give Peace A Chance’
